summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration testing of Atlas AI landing page. All 14 listed features verified: page loads with no console errors, hero section + Three.js sphere canvas render, all 5 sections present, all 3 macOS cards + all 6 concierge cards + 4 awareness stats + FaceID visual render, navbar nav links scroll to correct sections, hero/nav/final CTAs all open the Coming Soon modal with correct title 'Скоро серед вас.', modal closes via X / OK / ESC / backdrop, carousel prev/next buttons scroll the track (24 -> 364 -> 24), no horizontal overflow on desktop 1440 or mobile 375, mobile rendering is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: EnergySphere.jsx is ~287 lines including large inline GLSL shaders — acceptable, but consider extracting shaders into separate files for readability if it grows further.
Navbar inline styles are extensive; works fine for a static landing but moving to CSS modules / Tailwind classes would improve maintainability.

ComingSoonModal sets document.body.style.overflow = '' on cleanup which is fine for this app, but if other components also lock scroll it could clobber state — not an issue here since this is the only locker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page only; no backend; no API calls. Three.js canvas is mounted inside [data-testid='energy-sphere']. Modal close-on-backdrop works because parent onClick=onClose with inner stopPropagation. Carousel scrollLeft moves by card width + 20px gap per click.
